verified_facts: OS Terrain 50 grid heights are verified at 4 m RMSE
OSTN15 is the definitive OSGB36 ETRS89 transformation
OSTN15 uses a one kilometre transformation grid with bilinear interpolation
OSTN15 removes the need for local Helmert transformations for accurate OSGB36 conversion
OSGB36 plus ODN height is represented by EPSG 7405 in OS guidance
ODN vertical datum is represented by EPSG 5701
OSTN15 native transformation is represented by EPSG 7953
OSGM15 ODN transformation is represented by EPSG 7711 in OS guidance
British National Grid alone is horizontal and does not define a vertical reference
approximate WGS84 to OSGB36 ODN Helmert transformation can have errors up to 3.5 m at 95 percent
approximate Helmert transformation must not be used where sub-metre accuracy is required
Terrain 50 must be treated as independent coarse-reference evidence rather than parcel-scale elevation truth
quality_effect: Prevents metre-level approximate coordinate transforms and coarse Terrain 50 heights from contaminating parcel-scale elevation differences.
